propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically emit confidence=0.0 due to missing required fields in the batch entry JSON schema contract, causing all verdicts to fall below the 0.7 threshold and never surface to aggregate.
The flat output_token_limit=1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (K up to 20 candidates, ~100+ tokens per entry), causing the model to abstain the whole batch.
Single-candidate verdicts worked throughout because the issue only affected batched rendering, allowing unit tests with canned runners to pass while the live feature remained non-functional.
The batch entry contract requires candidate_id, relation, confidence, and abstain to be non-optional, with output budget scaled to 256 + 192*n tokens per batch to accommodate real verdict sizes.
A calibration test case verifying that near-duplicate pairs surface with confidence ≥0.7 while unrelated pairs remain unsurfaced must be committed to prevent silent regression.
